operation_result_model.change: Add explicit component_evidence role. Composite operation has exactly one composite_v1 primary and three predeclared H1 v1/v2 components. Component artifacts are not supporting_governance and do not contribute to result_item_count.
operation_result_model.existing_ordinary_results: Remain valid; legacy primary result_item_count behavior is unchanged.

counts.canonical_item_count: sum of canonical H1 items in usable components
counts.native_observation_count: sum of H1 v2 native observations
counts.item_count: composite primary artifact item_count equals canonical_item_count
counts.operation_result_count: legacy result_item_count counts primary artifact item_count only; component/native counts do not alter it

result_v3.change: Add a disjoint exact-schema-version branch for trading_status_context_composite.v1. Existing H1 v1/v2 branches and unrelated evidence families remain supported.

bundle_v1.purpose: Carry explicit artifact role and evidence contract metadata through the operation bundle.

execution_receipt_v1.purpose: Preserve explicit artifact role and contract metadata for lineage.

audit_v3.result: Generic artifact references remain sufficient; builder maps the composite primary while source-specific component artifacts and attempts remain independently traceable.

composition_semantics.aggregate_coverage: Union of validated canonical covered_status_types from usable components; uncovered is the canonical five minus that union. Native observations add no canonical coverage.
composition_semantics.aggregate_status: partial while usable evidence is incomplete. With no usable component evidence, deterministic failure precedence is binding_failed, source_failed, unsupported, then not_applicable when all components are not applicable; each component status remains present.
composition_semantics.no_match: Preserve component-local status and coverage; do not infer normal trading or promote to no_evidence_in_covered_scope without its H1 completeness conditions.
semantic_non_promotion: SuspensionOfTrading=Ｙ remains native unresolved evidence and adds no suspension coverage.
Blank or absent target row does not mean normal trading.
Historical resumption does not establish current tradeability.
Successful configured retrieval does not establish complete five-type H1 coverage.
identity_and_rejection_rules: Exact target id, market, and security code must match every component.
Component sources are restricted to the predeclared ordered representative set.
Reject duplicate component id, source contract, artifact hash/reference, mismatched target, unapproved source, unsupported H1 schema, or artifact/reference/evidence hash mismatch.

support_chain.lineage: An explicit composite-operation path requires one composite primary and exactly the authorized source components; ordinary duplicate_binding and duplicate_phase_h_typed_artifact checks remain unchanged.
support_chain.bundle: Component artifacts preserve relative_path, SHA-256, schema_version, byte_size, item_count, evidence_contract, and artifact_role. Only primary evidence contributes to legacy result_item_count and total_item_count.
support_chain.result_readback: Result V3 H1 v1, H1 v2, and Composite v1 are accepted without rewriting persisted packages. Rollback/preferred-output changes affect new materialization only; stored Result V3 remains readable.
support_chain.audit: Audit V3 schema unchanged; composite primary and independent component source attempts/artifact references retain path, hash, schema version, and citation lineage.
support_chain.handoff: Composite components render separately. Native observations retain source-native label/value/date, unresolved caveat, citations, and explicit no-inference wording; no synthetic canonical status is produced.
support_chain.mcp: Existing read_result and export_ai_handoff surfaces carry the evolved Result; no public tool/schema expansion.

offline_fixtures.C2_independent_failure: PASS: attention success, disposition source_failed, and cmode native partial remain visible.
offline_fixtures.C3_exact_target_no_match: PASS: no normal-trading inference; component-local no-match semantics retained.
